title: When the Portrait Falls
author: Noor Underhill
blurb: Emrys Halloran, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
